# FillStyleExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Add patterns and styles to polygon fills.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/fill-style-extension",
  "type": "FillStyleExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/fill-style-extension').par.fillPatternEnabled` (an input) and `op('/fill-style-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.fillPatternEnabled`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
